description: This file contains a test class 'ConnmanTest' for testing the 'connman' connectivity manager in a Yocto/OpenEmbedded development environment. It defines methods to check the service status, verify the help output of connman, and ensure the 'connmand' process is running, using various decorators for test dependencies and package requirements.

classes.name: ConnmanTest
classes.description: Test class for the 'connman' service, extending OERuntimeTestCase to implement specific connectivity tests.

methods.name: service_status(self, service)
methods.description: Checks the status of a given service, using systemd if available or returning an error message.

methods.name: test_connmand_help(self)
methods.description: Verifies that the 'connmand --help' command executes successfully, depending on the 'connman' package being installed.

methods.name: test_connmand_running(self)
methods.description: Checks whether the 'connmand' process is actively running, and logs service status if not.
